messages:
mira: Heads-up: AtlasCloud just submitted a marketplace entitlement for bergen-eu-north3. Need quota + KMS approval before we can flip the listing. Partner is asking for a go-live week of May 4 — threading here for approvals + ops runbook.

andreas (AtlasCloud): Thanks Mira — Atlas rep here. We're targeting an initial capacity of 4 A100-equivalent GPUs (burst to 8 for first 72h), 1TB egress cap. We'll sign the marketplace addendum.

samir: eng-platform here — to be explicit we need: provider quota (4xA100 equiv), VPC peering, image registry ACLs, node-pool sizing, and KMS access. Also please confirm expected max sequence length / model sizes so we can pick instance types.

liam: security note — KMS flow is acceptable but we need a key policy template and an audit log retention plan. Preference is Redwood-managed KMS with cross-account limited usage; if partner insists on hosting keys, we need an HSM attestation.

mira: Partner prefers Redwood-managed KMS for simpler rotation. andreas, can Atlas accept our KMS with restricted export and usage scoping?

andreas (AtlasCloud): Atlas can accept Redwood-managed KMS with restricted export. We'll need an onboarding contact for the KMS API keys and a region endpoint. Also need private registry pull creds for model bundles.

samir: Ops checklist (draft):
```
- Open provider quota ticket (region: bergen-eu-north3)
- Provision GPU pool: 4xA100-eq, node-pool labels: marketplace=atlas, canary=true
- Network: VPC peering + routes, egress cap enforcement
- KMS: create key + key policy, grant atlas service principal read/use
- Registry: create ACL for atlas model images
- Marketplace: metadata, SKUs, billing mapping
- Rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-fallback
```

jess: Legal — marketplace listing requires an MSA addendum + DPA annex. I'll prepare a redline today and send to nina@atlascloud.com. We should flag any special revenue share or tax clauses now.

mira: Timeline proposal: submit provider quota request today (ETA ~72h), parallel KMS onboarding + legal redline. Target soft-launch May 6 (canary), full listing May 13. Objections or blockers?

liam: Security wants the short questionnaire answered by EOD Tue. I'll drop the template into this thread shortly. Also need to confirm vulnerability scan cadence for partner images.

fluxbot: Quota ticket created: Q-34287 (provider portal). Provider ETA ~72h. Link: https://support.provider.tickets/Q-34287

andreas (AtlasCloud): Partner legal contact is nina@atlascloud.com, she'll review the MSA addendum. KMS onboarding intro ok for Friday 10:00 UTC — sending calendar invite. Registry creds flow accepted via SSO or short-lived tokens.

samir: I'll allocate the infra change and tag @samir-oncall for the deployment window. I'll set up canary routing hooks and health checks.

mira: :thumbsup: I'll consolidate action items into the partnership kickoff doc and follow up with a calendar for the dev + ops sync. Thanks everyone — will update when provider quota is approved.
